description: Acquisition, LBO, MBO, MBI, OBO, management buyout, transmission, growth buyout
screening_use: Lead PE buyer when control and deal mandate are supported; compare size/sector/ownership.
boundary_rule: LBO and growth buyouts belong here; small/mid/large are attributes, not buckets.

description: Capital-developpement, expansion, growth equity, financing growth of established businesses
screening_use: Minority capital partner or potential control buyer only when explicitly supported.
boundary_rule: Do not treat all Growth Equity as majority buyer.

screening_use: Usually relevant for growth financing rather than traditional established-business M&A.
boundary_rule: Venture-growth overlap recorded as secondary Growth Equity only where explicit.

description: Turnaround, restructuring, rescue, distressed/complex industrial acquisition
screening_use: Specialty buyers for turnaround or structurally complex situations.
boundary_rule: A plain carve-out or transformation is not sufficient alone for special-situations classification.

description: Infrastructure equity, asset-backed platforms, hospitality property, project investing
screening_use: Relevant when target is infrastructure/real assets, subject to asset vs operating-company check.
boundary_rule: Use asset_subtype to distinguish infrastructure from real estate/hospitality.

description: Mezzanine, senior debt, quasi-equity, flexible/hybrid investment capital
screening_use: Financing provider; not a standard lead control buyer by default.
boundary_rule: Equity ticket fields must not be populated with total mezzanine/debt commitments.

description: Dedicated co-invest mandates alongside financial sponsors
screening_use: Co-investor as partner; not standalone lead buyer by default.
boundary_rule: Keep underlying buyout exposure as strategy tags, not an automatic direct-buyer status.

description: Family/private holding, evergreen own-balance-sheet direct investing
screening_use: Long-term strategic / financial owner; screen on actual stake, sector and holding preferences.
boundary_rule: Evergreen fund alone does not imply a family holding; ownership source matters.
